text: Text was hard to read on its background. Use light text on dark backgrounds and near-black text on light backgrounds.
Stacked text layers overlapped. Keep at least 1.2 x the font size between the y positions of two lines, and time them apart.
A draft was almost a copy of an existing design (ui-106-command-palette, 84% alike). Always change backgrounds, animation family, transitions and layout when borrowing ideas.
Long text got cut off at the canvas edge. Keep every text line short: width is about characters x size x 0.6 and must stay under 90% of the canvas width.
Consecutive scenes looked alike. Give every scene a different layout archetype.
The whole video used one background style. Change background style between scenes with a fade.
There were no transitions between scenes. Use wipe, iris, stripes, flash or glitch transitions at scene changes.
Avoid relying on proprietary or complex file formats (like specific Filmora versions) for final delivery; ensure compatibility.
Do not use a high density of complex elements (e.g., over 20 layers or excessive custom/icon usage) if the core message delivery is failing.
